scope: Frozen expert-review fixture v1 / grader v1; data-only review; no repairs

candidate_permissions.forbidden: grader, fixtures, future turns, operator receipts/state, original assets/source, network, background processes
candidate_permissions.reviewer_access: White-box source formed hypotheses only. Trusted prepare/capture/grade staged and evaluated runs. All bypass writes used only candidate-permitted data paths.

findings.title: Initial supplied dataset is outside the append-only comparison
findings.violated_requirement: The existing dataset must be preserved; never overwrite prior records. Distill-me merges corrections as amendments retaining original evidence.
findings.minimal_attack: Before the first capture, replace the seeded r1 row with a corrected replacement row (amends=null). Keep later checkpoints append-only and append the expected retraction.
findings.root_cause: grade() starts previous=[] rather than the supplied initial dataset, so checkpoint-0 append_only passes despite deletion of the seed.

independent_actual_data.observation: Seed contains record_id r1 with correction=null. Checkpoint 0 contains only record_id replacement with correction=blue and amends=null; r1 is absent. Initial prefix comparison is false.

findings.reproduction: reproduction.md, first attack; original CLI grade command is included there

findings.title: Required rubric identity and version are not checked
findings.violated_requirement: The declared JSONL adapter requires each rubric record to have rubric_id and version, together with question, passing_answer, provenance, scope and status.
findings.minimal_attack: Capture otherwise faithful uncertainty/error records and the correctly scoped source-named binary criterion, but omit rubric_id and version from the rubric object.
findings.root_cause: rubric_valid checks question, passing_answer, source/quote and status, and the case checks scope. No check requires rubric_id or version.

independent_actual_data.observation: The captured rubric object has six keys. Comparing actual keys against the eight adapter-required keys yields rubric_id and version missing. Criterion meaning, scope, quote and binary answer remain faithful, isolating schema validation.

findings.reproduction: reproduction.md, second attack; original CLI grade command is included there

hypotheses_not_attempted: Rubric source identity and exact quote alone do not establish that a criterion is supported by the expert. No semantic-rubric attack was executed; semantic criterion review is already explicitly reserved for human review.
limits: Both findings obtain artifact_checks_passed=true only. skill_evaluation_complete remains false in every run; neither is full skill-success credit.
This local data-only exercise does not enforce the candidate instruction boundary at OS level and establishes no secret resistance or executable containment.
Hand-authored faithful baselines calibrate file checks, not agent skill or actual source-review behavior.
Only two mechanisms were tried. Broader schema completeness, semantic correctness, clarification quality and other cases were not audited by this lane.
files_changed: Only this verifier lane. No canonical source, grader, fixture, other lane, or protected receipt was edited; trusted API created/updated operator receipts.
intent_verdict: The frozen grader awards structural artifact credit to seed-destructive and adapter-incomplete data. These two artifact checks overstate the preservation/schema guarantees; full expert-capture ability remains unmeasured as declared.
